svg.title: 4K NVIDIA browser lifecycle completes 1800 handoffs; daily use open; backend 4 of 8; desktop product 0 of 4
svg.desc: A private browser integration completes 1800 GPU handoffs, terminal input and cursor response, terminal resize, four focus checkpoints, browser close/reopen and live cleanup. Both sessions pass GPU compositing, NVIDIA shader and all 17 observed GPU-thread sandbox checks. Complete first/final source-to-SDL pixels pass. Fixture startup synchronization changed; official input code did not. Ordinary browsing, normal launcher, long sessions, pressure recovery, broader APIs and matched-native performance remain open. Updated October 27, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Latest: 1,800 GPU handoffs; sandboxed browser close/reopen and terminal input pass
Ordinary browsing, long sessions, pressure recovery and daily-use acceptance remain open
Next: visible wallpaper/window layout, browser scrolling/typing/tabs and longer sessions
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-27
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
